learning_from.description: The learner's explanation/source language. Every registered learn-from language may participate when its localized bridge copy exists.

learning_language_full.description: A currently learnable target language with researched family-member distinctions, representative terms, an English canonical explainer, cultural cautions, and practice-ready relation features.

learning_language_comparison.description: A registered language may still be shown as a source-language anchor or future comparison target when only localized bridge copy exists, but the lesson must not invent a target vocabulary system or practice items.

runtime_model.source_first: Show a short bridge in the learner's strongest learning-from language before teaching the target system.
runtime_model.target_second: Resolve the selected learning language's structured target profile and render a longer explanation, term set, distinctions, cultural note, examples, and practice.
runtime_model.pair_scaling: Do not author a 104 x N matrix. Source copy and target facts are independent assets joined at runtime, so English to Spanish, Greek to Portuguese, Chinese to English, and Nepali to Portuguese use the same lesson graph.
runtime_model.fallback: If a source localization is below the user's trust threshold, fall back through the normal best-language chain. If the target lacks a full profile, render comparison-only and omit target practice rather than guessing.
runtime_model.english_spanish_reference: The approved worked example is English as the source language and Spanish as the learning language.
